new_assertions.title: endpoint residual correction flattens the shortest route pair
new_assertions.body: Define corrected_route_bit = observed_route_phase XOR final_P0_residual_197700_membership for the two shortest routes. The corrected bit is 0 on both routes.

new_assertions.title: the shortest obstruction alone does not force a larger phase codomain
new_assertions.body: Because the shortest 5x4 contradiction is satisfiable after a strict state refinement while retaining one Boolean phase value per refined node and retaining all four edge deltas, this witness alone does not establish that a higher-dimensional, non-binary, or non-abelian phase codomain is necessary.

new_assertions.title: two refined target identities are locally necessary and sufficient
new_assertions.body: Any state-refinement-only scalar repair of the shortest witness must place final states 197402 and 197403 in distinct refined target identities, and the represented residual-bit split provides exactly such two distinct target identities with a satisfying scalar assignment.
new_assertions.scope: shortest 5x4 obstruction; state-refinement-only scalar repairs preserving routes/deltas

new_assertions.title: concrete 4x4 flat witness has exactly two complement-related assignments
new_assertions.body: The six-node concrete 4x4 zero-delta reconvergence system has exactly two Boolean node-potential assignments: all nodes 0 and all nodes 1.

new_assertions.title: fixing the 4x4 source phase uniquely fixes the concrete flat witness
new_assertions.body: In the explicit 4x4 two-route witness, fixing the source node phase uniquely fixes every other represented node phase.

new_assertions.title: local residual refinement restores ordinary global-complement gauge freedom
new_assertions.body: Both the explicit flat 4x4 witness and the residual-bit-refined shortest 5x4 witness have exactly two satisfying scalar assignments related by global complement; the local residual refinement removes the contradiction without introducing additional absolute phase choices in that witness.
new_assertions.scope: comparison of the two explicitly primitive-supported finite constraint systems
